1: Body tired, mind won't shut off at night? This one's for you.
2: I've laid there plenty of nights, replaying the whole day and every bill.
3: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep:
4: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.
6: Remember Jesus in the boat? The storm was throwing water over the side.
7: And He was in the back, asleep on a pillow, because He knew Who held it.
8: So we made something for those nights: the whole Book of Psalms, read slow.
9: Calm voice, soft rain underneath, and a dark screen that won't light up your room.
10: Ten hours of Scripture, start to finish, and nothing in it to jolt you awake.
11: Let me pray over your rest right now.
12: Father, quiet every racing mind, and let Your Word be the last voice tonight.
13: Keep them safe through the night, like You promised. In Jesus' name, amen.
14: Tonight, put the phone face down and play the reading. It's linked right here.
15: Save this for the hard nights, and send it to somebody who can't sleep.
16: Rest well, and remember the Word for today. Have a blessed night.
